InferDroid native runtimes

LiteRT-LM v0.14.0-alpha.0
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/tree/0b98b80e1d846af27d10b8ab395645119cb231e4
Copyright The ODML Authors. Apache License 2.0.
The InferDroid adapter adapts the initialization/conversation sequence from
runtime/engine/litert_lm_main.cc. Changes: a C boundary callable through JNI,
document-descriptor model access, an explicit app native dispatch directory,
a bounded output length, diagnostics, and loaded-library verification.
No patches to the upstream LiteRT-LM runtime sources are applied.

LiteRT
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT/tree/43d8b4f20ef743a7c5beb69c365538e726cc20d9
Copyright Google LLC and contributors. Apache License 2.0.
libLiteRtDispatch_GoogleTensor.so is built from the pinned upstream source.

libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.so
Unmodified upstream LiteRT-LM prebuilt/android_arm64 artifact, obtained from
the above LiteRT-LM commit. SHA-256:
985ec5778144730b80666a0f71f1e06038eb07dd1a3e941c6ab7f963eda00a8e
Upstream repository license: Apache License 2.0.
Its implementation is supplied as a binary at this tag, not rebuilt here.

Root upstream licenses accompany this notice. Native dependency license files
available in the source build are collected into generated/LICENSES.txt.
This is a superset including build-only dependencies, not a claim about opaque
third-party internals of the upstream prebuilt constraint provider.

The proprietary device library /vendor/lib64/libedgetpu_litert.so, Tensor SDK
compiler, and Gemma model weights are not included in this APK or repository.
The vendor library is loaded from the physical Pixel through Android's linker.

Build strategy reference:
https://github.com/bejoyfuuul/litert-lm-tensor-g5-npu/tree/8f26b917dcd0dbe04f142f43a7c24f9141136d7f
No executable from that project's release is used as InferDroid's engine.

sherpa-onnx v1.13.8
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/tree/v1.13.8
Copyright Xiaomi Corporation and contributors. Apache License 2.0.
Built from the pinned source archive with ASR and Supertonic-only TTS enabled;
speaker diarization is disabled. scripts/prepare-tts-runtime.py selects only the
Supertonic TTS factory/sources in an ignored copy of the upstream build tree.
Additional changes: positional-capacity checks, private text redaction in error
logs, and exception-safe TTS C wrappers compiled inside the sherpa library.
ASR implementation sources remain unchanged.
InferDroid's independent JNI wrappers use its offline C API for CPU ASR and TTS.

ONNX Runtime 1.28.2
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.28.2
Copyright Microsoft Corporation and contributors. MIT License.
Android arm64 binary obtained from the sherpa-onnx maintainer's pinned archive:
https://github.com/csukuangfj/onnxruntime-libs/releases/tag/v1.28.2
The source build script packages the runtime's license and third-party notices,
plus licenses available for sherpa-onnx's compiled dependencies, under
generated/speech/. No TTS phonemizer or eSpeak library is included.

Whisper
https://github.com/openai/whisper/tree/v20250625
Copyright OpenAI. MIT License.
The separate Whisper tiny model bundle is exported/quantized by sherpa-onnx.
Whisper weights and public test recordings are not included in the APK or Git.
The upstream model license is retained under generated/speech/ for convenience.

Supertonic 3
https://huggingface.co/Supertone/supertonic-3
Copyright Supertone Inc. Model weights: BigScience Open RAIL-M License,
including its use restrictions; see generated/speech/supertonic-model-LICENSE.txt.
The sherpa model archive's MIT LICENSE covers Supertone's sample code, which
the upstream TTS implementation adapts; retained in supertonic-code-LICENSE.txt.
It does not replace the separate upstream model license. Model/data files and generated
speech are not bundled in the APK or Git. No voice cloning is implemented.
